name: Anthony Constantino
notes: No handle confirmed. News coverage (Fox News) says he posts on X, but no article I opened names his handle. Warning: constantinocongress.com is a parody site, not his campaign (City & State, https://www.cityandstateny.com/politics/2026/07/cutting-satire-pro-circumcision-constantino-campaign-flyers-are-fake/414691/), so do not take links from it. @stickermule is his company's account, not his own. I did not find his real campaign website; Ballotpedia returned an empty page.
